release.label: v1.0 RC1.4.17
release.baseline: RC1.4.16 + CMAA dashboard and dated CAP history isolation

sourceRules: CMAA source must be explicit; no date-based binding to CAP or arbitrary Full Status.
Official/draft/final visit working results and projections are separate.
CAP upload writes only the system working data; no state/event/visit updates.
Missing counts/identities remain unknown rather than being inferred from percentages.
limitations: Synthetic fixtures and in-memory Firebase adapter; no production database access.
Historical CAP rows previously discarded by cross-file duplicate suppression require reimport of the original dated documents.
